reviews.x: The image suggests that there is a 'yellow' paint tube, but there is not. It's actually 2 tubes of each color : green, blue, red. Otherwise, these tubes are bigger than a lot of the 'pre-packaged' paint kits.  Still need to have my 3-year-old try it out.

reviews.t: DO NOT BUY unless you like to scrub
reviews.x: I bought this product to add some extra fun in the tub for the kids... They painted away, it was awesome.. until it was time to drain the water. I had to SCRUB the tub with bleach spray and a brush to get the red residue from all over the tub and walls. But what's worse is I did not throw this product out sooner than my two year could get into it and spread it on my white duvet cover. I though bath paint would be closer to soap.. I was wrong. After stain spray, bleach, and about 6 washes the sta

reviews.t: So fun, but resist the temptation to use the whole tube in one bath - very soapy!
reviews.x: The grandkids had a ball, but it's too easy to use up the whole thing in one bath. Also it was very soapy and I had to rinse them off in the shower. Next time I'll have to ration it out more sparingly.  Warning:  The red scared the younger ones - they thought they were bleeding!

reviews.t: Makes bath time something the kid looks forward to doing
reviews.x: My daughter loves it and insists on painting during every bath. But her skin is pretty sensitive and I can always see a little irritation after she uses it. It's a good consistency, handles the water well and also washes off cleanly.

reviews.t: This product is a terrible mess to clean up
reviews.x: This product is a terrible mess to clean up;  If you have a hard water stain or real tile with grout stains the grout.  Be carefuL!!!!!
Great for the Grandsons!  They love the colors!

My daughter bought this at Target, not on Amazon.  My granddaughter started getting very uncomfortable in the bath and sores started appearing.  Google this and lots of warnings from customers.  Snopes says complaints are unproven, but my daughter and granddaughter are suffering the consequences.  Now my granddaughter doesn't want to take a bath.  I think it is terrible that with so many complaints this is still on the market!

reviews.t: It's fun and my daughter enjoys it but the price is ...
reviews.x: It's fun and my daughter enjoys it but the price is high, you can buy 3oz bottles from target for $1.  Also it doesn't really "paint."  It just comes out colorful but that's it.
These cause rash. Please read packaging. It warns parents about the paints. My son broke out with severe rash after using small amounts 2 times after purchase! Very unsafe.

reviews.t: My grandkids love these! Only complaint is I wish they were ...
reviews.x: My grandkids love these! Only complaint is I wish they were a little darker and they had yellow rather than green.
Before purchasing this item, make sure your child does not have a red dye allergy

reviews.t: $1.49 in stores!  Impossible to paint with!
reviews.x: The concept of these is great, but I don't recommend them for 2 reasons.  First, they are so liquidy, it's impossible to "paint" anything with them!  They are the same consistency as your average conditioner, and they don't stay on the side of the bath wall as kids try to draw with it.  It ends up dripping right into the water.  The second problem I have with these is the price.  Amazon is usually pretty dang good with offering the best prices around.  I paid just over $19 for the 6-pack

Just to be clear these are paint SOAPS. Not just paint. People who are complaining about the consistency and color aren't taking that into account. I bought them for my 4 yr old son and he loves them! The package came with 6 paints...2 blue, 2 red & 2 green. Not like the picture that shows yellow but I read the description and reviews before I bought them and knew that. The colors are bright and vibrant and can be mixed to make different colors. I am super impressed with how well they clean up t

I was hoping the crayola fingerpaint would have a little more substance. It has plenty of color but you still can't paint anything with your finger, not even a simple heart. After the newness wore off, they don't even really care about it. The item that has really excited them has been the drop in color fizzies. Go figure

We LOVE this paint, which should be evidenced by our willingness to shell out ridiculous sums of money for something that will go quite literally just down the drain. Great smell, great great texture, doesn't stain.

Every bath was a battle but now my son jumps up at bathtime because he knows it's time to "paint". Thank you, Crayola!  (They do stain the grout but I'd much rather have colorful grout than a dirty child!)

reviews.t: I think this would be good for a toddler past the mouthing stage of development
reviews.x: My grandson (14 months) is a little young yet for this because he is more interested in tasting it rather than painting with it.  I think this would be good for a toddler past the mouthing stage of development.
My niece loved this (3 y/o), the only complain is the pink/red is a little difficult to wash off once it dries onto the tub, so make sure when the kids are done to wash it off immediately
Fun idea, poor execution. This paint (that is supposedly soap) stains everything - tile, grout, bath mat...it's pretty fun, but just not worth ruining your bathroom for.
My kid just got a rash from this so I felt like I needed to write a review to let others know.
Colors aren't very bright when used as bathtub paint.  I wouldn't purchase again.
Too watery .. not like the original product.

We first bought this item at Target and my 2 yo son loved it. This size was larger, so that was nice bc my son goes through it fast. He doesn’t really use it to paint , it doesn’t work that well if you are actually trying to paint on our tub to make something specific. He uses it to spread color all over his body, it’s also soap so it’s fun. He does spread it around on the tub sometimes. If you use enough it will turn the water into whatever color you use. My grandkids love to use these finger paint soaps and it is easy to clean when I take my shower later. I hate that it is becoming more difficult to find in the stores. My first order was the wrong size, sent 3 oz not 6 oz as advertised, replacement was the same and returned for a refund which is why it received a 1 star rating.

Grandchildren enjoyed these Crayola Bathtub Fingerpaints but I would not buy again. They do not stain the tub but they DO stain any material they come in contact with such as towels, wash clothes, bath rugs, etc. The stains do not come out even with stain treatment. The fun is not worth that.

claims.text: Many reviewers say kids love it and it makes bath time fun, though some note the novelty wears off.
Several reviewers report staining, residue, or hard-to-clean messes in the tub, walls, and grout.
Some reviewers report skin irritation, rashes, or sores, with warnings about red dye allergies.
Reviewers note the consistency is too liquidy to actually paint with and that the set lacks yellow (two tubes each of red, blue, green instead).
Some reviewers find the price too high compared to cheaper store alternatives.
